name: AtomStack A24 Ultra
tagline: Step-up A24 with more diode power and refined hybrid workflow
tldr: AtomStack A24 Ultra is the higher-tier A24 with more diode power and updated hybrid layout. Same use case as A24 Pro: metal marking plus organic work in a compact box: with more headroom for cutting.
mainObjective: Premium compact hybrid Atomstack for metal + wood shops

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Strongest cut headroom in the line: about 5 mm basswood-class stock in benchmarks
24W: the most cut-focused head in the AtomStack A24 Ultra line
Software listed on the profile: test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers AtomStack A24 Ultra. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Compact hybrid production for mixed material personalization.

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack A24 Ultra 24W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.
